scenarios.observed: prototype-journeys.mjs completed all 8 journeys (discovery and empty zone; sold-out meal; delivery checkout through placement, uncertain-response message, pending acceptance and every order state to completion with customer-only handover code; pickup checkout without delivery fee; stock-changed warning blocking submission; cook accept and reject; ops kitchen approval and cash-discrepancy case) in Arabic RTL and English LTR at 390 px and 1280 px with no page errors and no horizontal overflow; 56 screenshots captured. The visual approval record (docs/design/approval.md) is PENDING with no reviewer or decision, so approval is recorded separately and not fabricated.

findings: Journey automation found a real prototype defect: the 'checking your order' status was always visible because the flex class overrode the hidden attribute; fixed with a [hidden] rule.
Navigation lag between URL hash and rendered screen; prototype now navigates and renders synchronously and the runner waits for expected screens instead of one-shot visibility checks.
Harness artifact: a full-page screenshot between input and click made the next click get lost in English desktop (Chromium headless); screenshot moved before the interaction, assertions unchanged.
Visual self-review fixes: styled 44px language toggle, Arabic-Indic quantity digits, larger policy checkbox.
This is a web prototype with synthetic data; it does not verify native mobile screens or real backend rules. Owner visual approval is PENDING (O05).
